summary.name: Veloren
summary.one_liner: Veloren is a multiplayer voxel RPG written in Rust, inspired by Cube World, The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, Dwarf Fortress and Minecraft.
keywords: zelda breath of the wild inspired
use_cases: playing a multiplayer voxel RPG with friends
browsing the Veloren game source code
hosting a self-hosted multiplayer game server
finding open source alternatives to Cube World or Minecraft
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitLab repository page for Veloren, a multiplayer voxel RPG written in Rust. The meta description says it is inspired by Cube World, Zelda: Breath of the Wild, Dwarf Fortress and others. The visible page text shows only the branch and tag selector (master default, 19 branches, 20 tags including v0.2.0 through v0.18.0, weekly and nightly) and an empty file listing. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it under Games as a multiplayer RPG licensed GPL-3.0. Gameplay details are not present in the page text.
notable: Multiple tagged releases from v0.2.0 to v0.18.0 plus weekly and nightly builds
caveats: Page text is mostly repository navigation; gameplay and platform support are not described on the page
